decks.notes: This deck aims to control the game through card advantage, counterspells, and removal while utilizing the power of its companion, Lurrus of the Dream-Den. It includes a mix of powerful Vintage staples like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Force of Will, along with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Null Rod and Wasteland to hinder the opponent's game plan. With a focus on generating incremental advantages and out-valuing the opponent, this deck aims to grind out wins through attrition and resource management.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful card draw and mana acceleration provided by Paradoxical Outcome to quickly cycle through the deck and assemble a combo win condition. By utilizing artifacts like Moxen and Mishra's Bauble along with tutors like Demonic Tutor and Merchant Scroll, the deck aims to generate a large amount of mana and draw into key combo pieces. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo and interact with the opponent's game plan.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo to take infinite turns, while also generating mana and card advantage with Coveted Jewel and Paradoxical Outcome. It includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo, and utilizes mana acceleration from Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith. The deck also has a versatile sideboard option in Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opposing strategies with artifacts. The key strategy is to control the game early and assemble the key combo pieces for a decisive victory.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent while maintaining card advantage through efficient spells and mana denial. With a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds a recursion element to ensure a steady stream of threats and answers. By leveraging powerful cards like Force of Will, Ancestral Recall, and Wasteland, this deck seeks to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through careful resource management.

The deck focuses on utilizing the dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures and spells, allowing for explosive combo plays. By leveraging cards like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Thug, and Bazaar of Baghdad, the deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam. Support cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation help protect the combo pieces, while Creeping Chill provides additional reach and potential life gain. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures and spells before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck aims to achieve a fast and disruptive gameplay by utilizing powerful artifacts and mana denial strategies. With cards like Mishra's Workshop, Crucible of Worlds, and Null Rod, the deck can quickly generate mana while disrupting the opponent's plans. Golos, Tireless Pilgrim provides additional utility and flexibility, allowing the player to search for key cards or lands as needed. The inclusion of cards like Trinisphere, Sphere of Resistance, and Wasteland further slows down the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to effectively respond to the deck's aggressive plays.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana through artifacts like the Moxen, Sol Ring, and Mana Crypt, to play powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge. It also aims to control the opponent's plays with cards like Chalice of the Void and Mental Misstep. The key synergy lies in using Manifold Key to untap powerful artifacts like Time Vault or Grim Monolith, allowing for explosive plays and potential game-ending combos. The deck leverages its artifact synergy to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly and efficiently through powerful artifact acceleration like Mana Vault, Sol Ring, and Moxen while utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to draw a large number of cards and replaying powerful artifacts for massive advantage. The deck aims to combo off by generating a large amount of mana and drawing into key pieces like Lurrus of the Dream-Den, Time Walk, and Ancestral Recall to win the game quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the game and protect its combo pieces.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through manipulating the opponent's resources with cards like Forbidden Orchard and Show and Tell, while also utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Oko, Thief of Crowns. The key strategy revolves around using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game, putting pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes a variety of disruptive spells like Flusterstorm and Force of Will to protect its game plan and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Ultimately, the goal is to establish board presence and outvalue the opponent through efficient plays and card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana production using artifacts like Moxen, Sol Ring, and Mana Crypt to power out threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Lodestone Golem. The deck also utilizes The One Ring and Manifold Key to generate card advantage and untap powerful artifacts like Time Vault. Additionally, it includes disruptive cards like Strip Mine and Glaring Fleshraker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive plays and powerful artifact synergies.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts to generate fast mana and overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures. It includes cards like Mana Crypt, Moxen, and Mishra's Workshop to ramp up quickly and play threats like Nettlecyst and Glaring Fleshraker. Key combo pieces like Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge help provide additional value and control over the game. The deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and pressure the opponent into submission before they can mount a defense.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful combo using cards like Paradoxical Outcome, Mystic Forge, and Mana Crypt to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards to find key pieces like Sol Ring and Time Vault. The deck also includes cards like Tinker and Karn, the Great Creator to search for specific combo pieces, while utilizing artifacts like Moxen to ramp up quickly. With the ability to generate explosive amounts of mana and draw through the deck rapidly, this deck is capable of winning the game in a single turn.

The Control - Planeswalker Control deck aims to establish early board control with disruptive cards like Collector Ouphe and Wasteland, while leveraging powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Oko, and Wrenn and Six to generate card advantage and control the game. The deck also includes powerful blue spells like Ancestral Recall and Force of Will to help protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining efficient removal, counterspells, and card advantage engines, the deck aims to outgrind and outvalue the opponent in a longer game.

The deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to efficiently cast powerful creatures and disrupt opponents with counter spells and removal. By utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to fuel graveyard shenanigans, combined with a strong aggro strategy featuring cards like Vengevine and Hollow One, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a fast and disruptive game plan. The key to success lies in effectively managing resources and timing interactions to create a potent and relentless aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing Paradoxical Outcome to generate a large amount of mana and draw through the deck quickly. It includes key combo pieces such as Tolarian Academy, Mox Opal, and Bolas's Citadel to create explosive turns and win the game in a single turn. The deck also includes various tutors and control elements like Force of Will to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. Overall, the main goal is to assemble the key pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful combo finish.

The deck focuses on using disruptive spells and efficient creatures to control the game and out-value the opponent. It utilizes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Urza's Saga to maintain control of the board while generating card advantage. The deck also includes a selection of versatile removal spells like Fatal Push and Wasteland to deal with threats efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and recursion for the deck's strategy. Ultimately, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and grind out a victory through attrition and efficient resource management.
